## Q2 premise census
Writes inside a settle come from CA lvalue writes, md resolution and delayed-CA scheduling. RENAME drivers `assign n = m` are ordinary CAs (alias.rs module doc) and wire vector ports, so they carry read sets and the closure applies to them; read_through.rs (proc_read_alias) is the process read path. No write channel outside net-id CAs/md found. Lanes (index_lanes t0_hold.rs:287-310) use the static held set: held_always = ca_always ∩ held, md_held = groups with any held member, held_delayed = delayed ∩ held. A non-held md group / ca_always / delayed CA reads no held-driven net (closure), and the waves write only held-driven nets (released held CAs, md groups with a held member). Measured: r3a, r3b (port tie), r3e.
